resources.string: Tap ⋮ at the top right, then Allow restricted settings. If it isn\'t there, try turning the service on once first.
Off, and Android blocks it until you allow restricted settings. Tap to open App info, then ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then come back and turn it on.

Android blocks accessibility and notification access for apps installed from a file, like Pastiera, until you allow it once:

1. Tap Open App info.
2. Tap ⋮ at the top right, then Allow restricted settings, and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint.
3. No Allow restricted settings under ⋮? Go back, try to switch the feature on once (Android says it's a restricted setting), then return to App info: it shows up after that.
4. Come back to Pastiera and switch the feature on.
